title: Plastic Wars (full documentary) | FRONTLINE
summary: A FRONTLINE documentary on whether efforts to fix plastic pollution made it worse. It looks at the battle over plastics and recycling and how little plastic is actually recycled.
why: HN recommends it as an eye-opener on how recycling was promoted by the plastics industry despite not working.

quote.text: If you want to have your eyes opened about just how little of the material you probably think you are recycling actually gets recycled
